title: PHI-SWARM: Physics-Hybrid Integrity Framework for Secure Autonomous UAV Swarms
description: Software L0-L9 framework for integrity-gated federated PHM on multi-UAV swarms. Physics-twin data stays local; only signed weight deltas are exchanged. Reproducible validation suite, threat model, and audit trail. No flight claims. Developed at Penelope Inc. (PHI Lab).
